name: What does an office sound-control assessment include?
description: An assessment inspects walls, ceiling plenums, doors, and ductwork to identify how noise travels and determine the right structural fixes.

mainEntity.name: What does an office sound-control assessment include?

acceptedAnswer.text: An office sound-control assessment evaluates how noise travels through walls, ceilings, floors, doors, and mechanical systems in a workspace. During the evaluation, a contractor inspects structural assemblies, duct pathways, perimeter seals, and room finishes to pinpoint flanking paths and weak points. Practical factors such as whether sound leaks through hollow-core doors, unbaffled return air grilles, or open ceiling plenums will dictate the remediation approach. The assessment provides a baseline scope of work so you can address speech privacy and background disruption systematically rather than guessing which materials to install.
